para_examples.original: I'm planning to price for value and stability this round, and I'd expect the market to be healthiest when everyone prices sensibly rather than chasing short-term share. I'll be holding a firm, premium price.
para_examples.delivered: This round, I intend to set prices based on value and stability, and I believe the market will be at its strongest when every participant prices sensibly rather than pursuing short-term share. I will be maintaining a firm, premium price.

para_examples.original: Our focus this season is on quality and long-term value, and we're committed to pricing that reflects it rather than racing to the bottom. We hope the market stays healthy for everyone.
para_examples.delivered: This season we're prioritizing quality and lasting value, and we intend our pricing to reflect that instead of competing to be the cheapest. We wish the market well for everyone involved.

para_examples.original: The market looks healthiest when pricing reflects real value, and I'm moving up to a premium level this round and intend to hold it steady. I'd expect sensible pricing to serve everyone better than chasing short-term share.
para_examples.delivered: Markets are at their strongest when prices track genuine worth, so I'm raising my pricing to a premium tier this round and plan to keep it there. I believe sound pricing will benefit everyone more than pursuing short-term market share would

para_examples.original: I'm staying committed to value-based pricing and a healthy market, and I'll keep my prices steady while we see how the season develops. Pricing that reflects quality benefits every participant over the long run.
para_examples.delivered: I'm holding to value-based pricing and a sound market, and my prices will stay where they are as we watch how the season unfolds. Setting prices that reflect quality serves everyone involved over the long term.
